input.structural_padding_rule: Exclude only the single contiguous trailing block whose identifier is blank and whose six expression cells are all blank or one of NA, N/A, #N/A, NULL; retain every row with a nonblank gene identifier, including all-zero genes.

filter_candidates.rule: CPM >= 0.5 in at least 3 of 6 samples
CPM >= 1 in at least 2 of 6 samples
CPM >= 1 in at least 3 of 6 samples
CPM >= 2 in at least 3 of 6 samples

primary_filter.rule: CPM >= 1 in at least 3 of 6 samples
primary_filter.selection_basis: Library-size-aware expression requirement in half of the libraries; selected without condition labels or sample-separation results.

qc_representation.library_size_denominator: raw column sum over all 60,675 valid gene rows
qc_representation.features: genes passing the frozen primary filter

pca.fit: samples as observations and genes as features

review_flags.library_size: outside 0.67 to 1.50 times the six-sample median
review_flags.mean_correlation: more than 0.05 below the median of the six mean off-diagonal correlations
review_flags.pca_position: two-dimensional nearest-neighbor distance greater than 3 times the median nearest-neighbor distance in at least two of three feature sets

outlier_review.technical_problem_confirmation: requires independent evidence of corruption, sample identity failure, or another documented technical defect; an isolated QC flag is insufficient

frozen_de_plan.input: official raw integer gene-count matrix after the frozen condition-blind testing filter
frozen_de_plan.testing_filter: CPM >= 1 in at least 3 of 6 samples
